propositions: The llm.headers gateway-observability surface lacks documentation in the existing LLM configuration pages, preventing operator discovery and increasing risk of credential exposure in committed files.

The llm.headers key resolution layers, value grammar (${env:...} and ${run:...}), and rejected header names must be documented in docs/config.md alongside other LLM knobs for operational discoverability.

The gateway-observability recipe, nginx underscore-stripping caveat, and Bedrock provider limitation must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with security guidance on environment variable referencing and header value non-recording.

The documentation must specify the exact closed vocabulary of ${run:...} substitutions (trace_id, ticket_id, operation) and list all five rejected header names (authorization, x-api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization) by their actual names as shipped.

The provenance record field header_names captures only header names, never values, and this behavior must be explicitly documented alongside the security guidance that values may contain credentials via ${env:...} but authentication headers are rejected.
